race.comment: JILLIBY RYDER (10) settled close to the pace then found the lead only to be claimed in the straight and finish third last start over 2270m at this track, that run on the back of an unplaced effort at this track the run before. Meets a comparable field and he can find winning ways. ROLLONART (6) scored at Shepparton three runs ago but has been unplaced in two subsequent runs, the latest when fifth over 1740m at this track, beaten 35 metres. Meets a similar line up and she can figure in the finish. SHARP INTEREST (4) is a big chance following a run of four top-three finishes, the latest at this track two weeks ago. Real threat to the top selections. LOMBOK (8) showed pleasing improvement last time out when runner-up over 2270m at this track.
